tex_content.html: For a complete connected nonflat three-dimensional flow with $\Rm \ge 0$ and a zero curvature-operator eigenvalue at time $T$, a cover splits as $(N,h(t))\times (\Ar ,ds^2)$, where $N$ has positive curvature and the flow is the product with the trivial line flow.
